breakpoints: 800px min-width app frame: below it the frame keeps 800px and the viewport crops it (no separate phone layout)
Main view width drives the content: 1045px gives 5 grid columns and 96px titles, 456px gives 2 columns and 32px titles

patterns.name: App frame
patterns.description: The document never scrolls. A black grid (padding 8px, gap 8px): 64px top bar across, then three columns (library 331px, main 1045px, right rail 40px at 1440; 280px / 456px / 32px when the frame is 800px), then an 82px bottom row (84px+16px when the strip text wraps). Each column is a #121212 panel with an 8px corner; only the main panel scrolls, inside itself.

patterns.name: Top bar
patterns.description: 64px, padding 8px. 32px mark at x28; 48px round #1f1f1f home button; 474x48 pill search field (#1f1f1f, padding 12px 96px 12px 48px, keyboard hint chips and a browse icon after a divider). Right: three 16px/700 #b3b3b3 text buttons 8px apart, a 1x25 white divider, an install link (14px/700 with a 16px icon), a sign-up text button and a 108x48 white log-in pill. In an 800px frame the search shrinks to a 48px icon button.

patterns.name: Library rail
patterns.description: Header 59px (16px 16px 8px padding): 16px/700 white title and a 35px round #1f1f1f plus button. Two #1f1f1f prompt cards (8px corner, padding 16px 20px, gap 20px): 16px/700 title, 14px line, small white pill. Footer pinned at the bottom: 12px #b3b3b3 legal links in rows (16px gap), one white cookie link, then the outlined language pill 32px tall.

patterns.name: Main view
patterns.description: Inner scroller with the page content then the footer. Home starts with a 256px grey wash fading to #121212 behind the first shelf. Entity pages start with a colour-washed header (276px album/playlist, 360px artist image, 270px genre) followed by a 173px lighter wash behind the action bar.

patterns.name: Footer
patterns.description: Inside the main view: 1px #292929 rule, then a 4-column link list (columns 193px apart from x24, heading 16px/700 white with 8px bottom padding, links 16px #b3b3b3 30px apart: 3, 7, 5, 5 links) with three 40px social discs at the right; another rule and a 14px copyright line at the right. 421px tall at 1045px, 1039px in a 456px view (columns stack). Links point to the marketing origin (www.spotify.com, support, newsroom, developer, ads, investors): listed, not rebuilt.

patterns.name: Sign-up strip
patterns.description: Bottom row: 66px strip with a 16px corner, linear-gradient(90deg, #af2896, #509bf5), padding 11px 24px 7px 15px; 14px/700 title over a 16px line, white 153x48 pill at the right.

patterns.name: Collapsed right rail
patterns.description: 40px #121212 panel (32px in an 800px frame) holding a chevron that opens the now-playing view; the open state is login-gated and not recorded.

layout.responsive: There is no phone layout: below 800px the frame keeps 800px and the viewport shows its left part (top bar mark, home and search buttons, the 280px library, 94px of the main view, the strip's left half). Between 800px and 1440px the library and main view resize; the main view switches its grid to 2 columns, 20px shelf titles and 32px entity titles at 456px.

principles: Build an app frame, not a page: black 8px gutters, rounded #121212 panels, the document never scrolls, only the main view does.
Every action is a pill (9999px). White pill for the primary, grey text for secondary, green only for play.
Covers carry the colour: entity headers take a wash of the cover's dominant colour and fade it into #121212 under the action bar.
Use two greys for text: #ffffff for names and headings, #b3b3b3 for everything else; no other text greys.
Keep line height 'normal' and type sizes on 12/14/16/24/32/96; weight 700 for UI labels, 800 only for giant titles.
Hover is quiet: links underline, buttons scale to 1.04, the card play button rises 8px into place.
avoid: Borders around panels or cards; separation comes from the black gutter
Green used for anything except play
A document-level scroll or a separate phone layout
